name: Ohimesama ni Narenakatta Kimi wa Tada Aisaretakatta Dake na no ni
original_name: お姫さまになれなかった君はただ愛されたかっただけなのに
source:
Tomoyo Inaba, the protagonist who ended up dating his male classmate Tatsuro Mizukoshi, continues his relationship with Mizukoshi, reluctantly responding to the confession made by the girl a few days ago.

――I have the worst awareness, but for some reason I didn't feel guilty.

[Taken from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5416]NovelGame[/url]]
